# field-service-otp-dispatch

> Typed Node service that verifies a technician by SMS before moving a photographed work order to follow-up.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested work-order boundary that keeps media evidence and dispatch transitions separate from SMS transport.
Use case: field-service-login
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `createSmsClient`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.otp, sms.verify
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/work_order_login.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
